organization.name: Lansweeper NV
organization.notes: Founded 2004 per official About. Private equity financing from Insight Partners and Dovesco disclosed 2021; July 2026 announcement identifies existing shareholder Imker Group. Bridgepoint majority acquisition remains an agreement expected to close by end 2026, subject to conditions in both vendor and acquirer pages. Insight/Imker exit and Dovesco retained minority are prospective terms; completion/current exact holdings unverified.

pricingTiers.name: Pro
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational plan: Pro includes 2000 assets expandable to 9000 and up to 3 installations.449/528/474 amounts have ambiguous currency labels; annual total not invented.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Enterprise custom annual contract starts 10000 assets; explicit Request a quote. Volume based on assets rather than seats.
